gloss: to swoop down; to descend gracefully

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {舞|ま}い{降|お}りませんでした

forms.negative: {舞|ま}い{降|お}りていなかった

definitions.gloss: to swoop down, to descend gracefully, to flutter down
definitions.explanation: To come down from above in a light, graceful manner. Used for birds landing, snow falling gently, or angels descending. Conveys elegance or lightness in the descent, unlike plain 降りる which is neutral.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りてきた。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りる⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a night when snow was gently falling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白鳥|はくちょう}→白鳥：04937_hakuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りる⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sight of the swan gracefully descending onto the surface of the lake was beautiful.

notes:
Ichidan verb (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧). {舞|ま}い{降|お}りる → {舞|ま}い{降|お}りない → {舞|ま}い{降|お}りて → {舞|ま}い{降|お}りた

USAGE:
A compound verb combining ⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (to dance, to flutter) and ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to descend). The ⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ component adds a sense of lightness and grace to the descent. Often used in literary or poetic contexts. Common subjects include birds, snow, leaves, and angels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りる: a bird swoops down
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りる: snow flutters down
- ⟦{天使|てんし}→天使：12174_tenshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{降|お}りる: an angel descends
